brief: This is a chart pack: 30+ single-line GS captions across trading, macro and AI-capex themes, not an argued note. It reports the current equity drawdown (-12%) exceeds historical norms, with GS's Vol Panic Index at 9.8/10 and the S&P 500 below 7,000, while breadth, negative-beta share and equity/bond correlation all show stress. History shows corrections like this one average +10% over 12 months with a 73% hit rate. Positioning is stretched both ways: mutual fund cash and CTA exposure have fallen (CTAs now short almost -$10bn, the lowest since April), L/S net leverage sits at a 5-year low, and HF VIP names suffered one of their worst drawdowns on record, even as ETF inflows, foreign flows and buyback authorizations ($1.52T 2026 YTD) stay strong. Separately, GS expects hyperscaler and AI-infrastructure earnings growth to decelerate into 2027 even as cloud revenue accelerates and AI debt issuance grows, and retains a constructive, central-bank-demand-driven gold view to end-2027, calling recent weakness speculative and temporary.
